items.publisher_timestamp_text: SEC complaint: Newswire Service 1 publicly disseminated Panera's press release at 4:00 p.m. ET on July 23, 2013.
items.release_title: Panera Bread Company Reports Q2 2013 diluted EPS of $1.74, up 16%
items.corroboration_basis: The SEC complaint states that Panera uploaded a press release to Newswire Service 1 at approximately 10:00 a.m. ET on July 23, 2013 and that Newswire Service 1 publicly disseminated it at 4:00 p.m. ET. Its table labels the time column ET and records the 4:00 p.m. public dissemination event. SEC Exhibit 99.1 independently matches Panera Bread Company, the July 23, 2013 Q2 2013 release title/results and revised FY2013 EPS target.
